title: Review of c03's size-decay no-turnover negative: replicates on fresh seed 3 (a=2: 24 -> 53 bodies, 28 splits, 3 deaths; a=5: 24 -> 29, splits only in the first window, 0 deaths)
summary: Ran world_a2.py and world_a5.py unchanged on seed 3 (T=960) and counted with the finding's turnover.py in six windows. a=2: micelles form by t~40, divide in waves (3, 0, 14, 3, 2, 6 splits) and grow to 53 bodies with 3 deaths in all; the sheet shows dividing pairs at t=376 and t=920 and no body dissolving. a=5: 3 splits in the first window, then none, 29 static bodies and 0 deaths. The mass-dependent catalyst decay slows or stops growth across the board instead of killing large bodies, as the finding says.

observations.D: turnover_s3.txt: a=2 splits 3/0/14/3/2/6, deaths 0/0/2/0/0/1, 24 -> 53 bodies; a=5 splits 3/0/0/0/0/0, deaths 0, 24 -> 29

controls_run.D: rerun/a2/seed3 vs rerun/a5/seed3 (two strengths, same seed)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and the same short T=960 as the finding; at a=2 the population is still growing at the end, so a later turnover regime is not excluded.
